codeReview.summary: The PluginResolver implementation perfectly matches the expected behavior. It correctly prioritizes project -> user -> org scopes, implements deduplication for skills, additive collection for hooks, and resolves droids. Missing directories and files are handled gracefully via try/catch blocks and existence checks. 39 tests passing cover all scenarios.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker used Select-String in PowerShell to pipe pnpm format:check output, which timed out. They had to fall back to calling prettier directly on the specific files. Adding a script or documentation on the preferred way to run format checks on specific files in Windows would save time.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript shows `pnpm format:check 2>&1 | Select-String -Pattern "resolver"` timing out after 60 seconds, followed by a successful `pnpm exec prettier --check .claude/lib/plugins/resolver.cjs tests/plugins/resolver.test.cjs`.

summary: PluginResolver review passed. Implemented with 39 passing tests and appropriate fallback logic.
